query:
find club as c
return c.name order by c.inception_year

find player as p
follow p receivesAward award as a
max p.date_of_death as latest_death
return latest_death

find club where name = "FC Luzern" as luzern
follow luzern playsFor player as p
follow p playsFor club as c
return c.name, c.owners
